**Professional Experience / Work History**  
At NexaCorp, I lead the development of scalable backend systems for their SaaS platform, focusing on microservices architecture and cloud-native infrastructure. My work involves designing REST APIs that balance performance and maintainability, while ensuring seamless integration with third-party services. I’ve spearheaded the migration of monolithic applications to Kubernetes-based deployments, resulting in a 40% reduction in infrastructure costs and improved system resilience. A key project involved optimizing PostgreSQL queries for a real-time analytics module, which increased data retrieval speed by 35% and supported a 200% growth in user engagement.  

Prior to joining NexaCorp, I served as a Senior Backend Engineer at CloudForge Solutions, where I architected a distributed system for managing IoT device data. This involved leveraging AWS services like S3 and Lambda to process over 10 million data points daily, while maintaining low-latency responses through asynchronous messaging. I also implemented monitoring solutions using Prometheus and Grafana, which reduced incident resolution time by 50%.  

In my early career at TechNova Solutions, I developed foundational backend services for a customer relationship management (CRM) platform. My contributions included building a modular Python-based API layer that enabled rapid feature iteration, and implementing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions to automate testing and deployment. This streamlined release cycles and improved team collaboration.  

**Projects / Side Projects**  
A side project focused on creating a real-time analytics dashboard for a startup specializing in smart energy solutions. Using Go and AWS Lambda, I designed a microservices architecture that processed sensor data and provided actionable insights within seconds. The project was later integrated into the company’s main platform, contributing to a 25% increase in customer retention.  

Another initiative involved developing a lightweight tool for automating infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and AWS CloudFormation. This tool simplified environment setup for new developers and reduced deployment errors by 60%. I also contributed to an open-source project optimizing PostgreSQL performance for high-concurrency workloads, which gained traction in the developer community.  

**Technical Skills / Technologies**  
I specialize in building resilient backend systems using Go for high-performance services, with a focus on concurrency and memory management. My expertise in Kubernetes includes managing deployments across multiple clusters, automating scaling, and ensuring zero-downtime updates. AWS is central to my workflow, where I design scalable architectures, configure load balancers, and monitor resource utilization through CloudWatch.  

PostgreSQL optimization is a core strength, particularly in environments requiring complex query tuning and partitioning strategies. I’ve also developed REST APIs that adhere to industry standards while prioritizing security and performance. My work with CI/CD pipelines ensures automated testing and deployment, reducing manual intervention and accelerating time-to-market.  

Linux administration skills are applied to maintain secure, high-availability servers, with a focus on system performance tuning and automation. GitHub Actions is used sparingly for continuous integration, ensuring code quality without overcomplicating workflows.
